records.name: Fidget
records.summary: A Philadelphia arts space called Fidget Space where artists rehearse, hold book club meetings, and run writing and brainstorming workshops. It also runs artist residencies and a bartering program.
records.what_you_do: Join a workshop or book club meeting, rent the space for your own practice, or apply for an artist residency or the bartering program.

schedule.text: No dates or regular times published on the site

first_step.how: Email info@thefidget.org to ask about the next workshop or book club meeting
first_step.basis: The site invites people to join its workshops and book club, and gives a general email for questions

records.notes: The site is working but shows no dated events or news, so status is probably_active by rule. Rental and residency pages were linked but not read.

records.name: FORTUNE
records.summary: A Philadelphia collective of queer and trans Asian artists, writers, and organizers. It holds gatherings and makes printed work, and its Many Folds Press runs a risograph print studio.
records.what_you_do: Join the mailing list for gatherings, collaborate on projects as a QTBIPOC artist or printmaker, or get in touch to join the community.

schedule.text: Gatherings are announced through the mailing list; no dates published

first_step.how: Sign up for the mailing list linked on printingfortunes.info, or email printingfortunes@gmail.com
first_step.basis: Gatherings are announced by mailing list and direct contact; the page does not describe an open drop in

records.notes: The newest dated item is the 2022 start of Many Folds Press (year only, no month). The site says it is a work in progress. Status is dormant by rule, but the group may still meet through private channels. Last sign of life is a year, not a month.

records.name: FringeArts
records.summary: A Philadelphia venue for experimental and do-it-yourself performance that also runs the Philadelphia Fringe Festival. Members of the public come as audience, take a workshop, or volunteer.
records.what_you_do: Buy tickets to shows and the festival, take a movement workshop, or sign up to volunteer. The venue also hosts a restaurant and a membership program.

schedule.text: Season events and workshops, including October 2026 dates: a movement workshop October 19 to 21, and FEASTIVAL on October 28

cost.text: Ticket prices are set per event on the ticket page, not listed in the text checked

first_step.how: Buy a ticket for an upcoming show, or sign up for the October 19 to 21 movement workshop, or email hello@fringearts.com to ask about volunteering
first_step.basis: Public shows and workshops are open to anyone who buys a ticket or registers; volunteer details are on the site

records.notes: This is a venue. Its public way in is attending, taking a workshop, or volunteering, as the brief asks. Ticket prices were not in the text checked. Category and interest are the closest fit; the venue presents experimental theater, dance, and performance. Ticket line is (215) 413-1318 and tickets email is patronservices@fringearts.com.

records.name: Gapura Philadelphia
records.summary: A community nonprofit serving Indonesian immigrants and their families in Greater Philadelphia. It helps with consular papers, bank accounts, and City ID, and runs cultural programs like Gamelan music, a youth group, and a summer culture camp for children.
records.what_you_do: Get help with paperwork and services, join the Gamelan or youth group, volunteer at events like the Indonesian Festival, or bring your family to the cultural events.

schedule.text: Office hours Monday to Friday, 10 am to 2 pm (closed on public holidays). Cultural events run through the year, with an August children's camp and an August Indonesian Festival.

cost.text: Consular services from $10, bank account setup $10, Philly City ID pay as you wish, space rental $50 per hour, administrative support from $1. Event prices not listed.

first_step.how: Call or text (215) 254-4475 or email info@gapuraphilly.org to ask about the Gamelan group, the youth group, or volunteering at the next festival
first_step.basis: The page says how to start: call, text, email, or use the contact form, and it names a volunteer application

records.notes: Event years are not given on the page. The Daun Indonesian Feast is listed as on hiatus for spring and summer 2026, which is the newest dated item, but its month is not stated. The camp and festival are listed as August with no year. Status is probably_active for that reason.

records.name: Georgia E. Gregory Interdenominational School of Music
records.summary: A faith-based music school on West Allegheny Avenue that teaches many instruments and voice, and trains young musicians for churches. It also gives young people a creative place to build music and social skills.
records.what_you_do: Take lessons on an instrument or in voice, theory, or dance, or join a group like the drumming or handbell classes.

first_step.how: Call (215) 430-0435 or use the Contact Us page on gegisom.org to ask how to enroll in lessons
first_step.basis: The site says Enroll Today but publishes no steps, eligibility, or schedule, so the way in is unclear

records.notes: Working site with no dated events or news, so status is probably_active by rule. Faith-based school: whether the public can enroll regardless of faith is not stated, so audience.faith is left blank. Fax number is (215) 430-0452.

records.name: Ginger Arts Center
records.summary: A youth-led art space in Philadelphia's Chinatown that opened in June 2024. It offers workshops, teach-ins, and art-making with professional equipment.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer, take part in a workshop or art session, or offer to lead one.

cost.text: One profile describes its programming as free

first_step.how: Contact the center through its website or social accounts to ask about volunteering or a workshop

records.notes: The center's own page loaded with only its title, so no site content could be read. Facts come from search results about its 2024 opening, not from the center itself. Status is dormant by rule (newest dated evidence 2024-06). Address and hours not found. Recheck the site or call before publishing a schedule.

records.name: Group Motion Multi Media Dance Theater
records.summary: A dance and movement group that runs workshops, retreats, and projects. Its site has a mailing list and a list of past events.
records.what_you_do: Join a movement workshop or retreat, or sign up for the mailing list to hear about new projects.

schedule.text: Workshop dates are linked on the site but not shown in the text checked

first_step.how: Join the mailing list or email company@groupmotion.org to ask about the next workshop
first_step.basis: Workshops are listed for the public, and the site offers a mailing list and a contact email

records.notes: The page text shows navigation only. No Philadelphia address, dates, or cost appear in the text checked, so the Philadelphia link is not confirmed from this page. Status is probably_active because the site works but shows no dates. Needs a check of Upcoming Workshops and Past Events.

records.name: Icebox Project Space
records.summary: A Philadelphia art space inside Crane Arts that shows artworks, performances, video, movement, and sound. It runs open calls for artists and holds opening receptions.
records.what_you_do: Visit an exhibit or opening reception, sign up for the newsletter, or answer an open call as an artist.

schedule.text: Gallery hours: Tuesday and Wednesday 6 to 9 pm, Friday and Saturday 12 to 9 pm. Exhibit openings are announced on the site.

first_step.how: Visit during gallery hours, or email icebox projects (at) gmail.com to ask about the next open call
first_step.basis: Public gallery hours and opening receptions are open to anyone, and the site gives an email for questions

records.notes: Newest dated item is the July 9, 2026 opening reception for the summer 2026 open call. Light and Sound 2026 is listed with no date. Volunteering and classes are not mentioned on the page.

records.name: IllReality, DBA MoveMakers Philly
records.summary: A hip hop dance school for kids ages 3 to 17 with locations on Chestnut Street. It teaches dance, music, parkour, and martial arts, runs after school and summer programs, and offers scholarships.
records.what_you_do: Sign kids up for dance, music, or after school classes, or ask about scholarships. The school also runs camps and adult classes.

schedule.text: After school pick up programs at both locations for the 2026 to 27 school year. Range of Motion camp dates include October 9 and 12, and November 3, 11, 16, and 25, 2026.

cost.text: Registration fee $100, with 5 percent off if you register by October 30, 2026. Other program prices are on the Rates and Registration page.

first_step.how: Register on the Rates and Registration page by October 30 for 5 percent off the $100 fee, or call to ask about scholarships through IAM THE MOVE or Say Yes Philly
first_step.basis: The school lists camps, birthday parties, and after school programs as ways to start, and names scholarship programs for families

records.notes: The site lists two phone numbers, (267) 600-1030 and (267) 519-2957. Confirm which is current. Email is obscured on the page, so it is left blank. Volunteering is not mentioned. Kind as nonprofit follows the batch; the scholarship programs suggest a community program but the legal form was not confirmed.

notes: 18 groups in batch. Fetched 11 sites successfully (fidget, food-beeatz, fortune, fringearts, gapura, gegisom, gingerarts, groupmotion, icebox, movemakers, imaginary-lines). Seven sites were rate-limited by the WebFetch safety check and were not retried after one failed retry; those records are marked unknown with low confidence. Ginger Arts Center's own page loaded empty; its facts come from search snippets. IMPeRFeCT Gallery's facts come from search snippets only. Food bEeatz's YouTube page showed no content. Search budget fully used (2 of 2). Every record is verdict publish, but the unknown ones lack a summary and categories, so the pipeline should hold them back. Ran out of fetch budget? No: the rate limit, not budget, stopped the remaining fetches.
